High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber]] (Premiere Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Premiere/Premiere Dark/Dark Jedi Lightsaber.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeQU94QUZlNnk2TDA/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Dark Jedi Lightsaber.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,136 bytes, SHA-256 <code>7d15b44251410780b363253b058c3083b1c96ab67d6e34937566e0d07e2b7123</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

{{HiRez scan note}}
